patterns: Search listboxes only when option density warrants it
Keep destructive controls visible on hover and keyboard focus

decisions: Use a ChatGPT-inspired neutral application shell with restrained cobalt interaction color.
Keep editing chrome dense and quiet so authored website frames remain the visual focus.
Use a four-panel workspace only when AI is open; otherwise preserve maximum canvas area.
Use custom accessible listboxes instead of native selects, adding search only for larger option sets.
Starter content remains ordinary undoable project data and can be removed down to an empty project.
Treat AI-responsive results as editable device frames and export them through explicit breakpoint media queries.
